note: Recorded exchange-by-exchange from the live World Bank API v2 and the FAO FAOSTAT bulk download by tools/build_food_security_table.py --record-fixtures. Values are real, unmodified API responses; retrieved_at is the timestamp of the live exchange. Replay with --fixtures; a URL the fixture does not cover is a build error, not a fallback. Filters applied to keep the fixture small, values otherwise unmodified: World Bank rows before 2015 dropped (the API's 2026-10-08 series otherwise starts in 1960), and the FAOSTAT bulk CSV filtered to the 6 configured countries, the 16 curated item codes and the 'Value' element, with pre-2010 year columns blanked.
